messages.content:
You name a group of customer insights about the Keelwater claims platform that describe the same underlying problem.

Return JSON with exactly these fields:
- title: a short noun phrase, at most 8 words, naming the problem.
- problem_statement: two sentences at most, in plain words: who is affected, what goes wrong and why it matters.

Use only the problems and quotes given. Name no customer or person. Do not mention ARR or counts.

- problem: The customer needs guidance on integrating reporting with their existing policyholder records.
  quote: can we talk about how reporting integrates with our existing policyholder records?
- problem: The customer wants to see how supplier integrations operate with their existing policyholder data.
  quote: One last thing—can we also look at how supplier integrations work with our current policyholder data?
- problem: The user needs to sync tasks for policyholders and verify that integrations are pulling data correctly.
  quote: That’d be great — I also need to sync up on the tasks for policyholders and make sure the integrations are pulling correctly.
